summary: A regeneration must keep three explicit signals: a truncation note when 'righe', 'cup', 'cig' or a 'dossier' section stops exactly on --limite (with the true total from contaRighe in 'righe'), the archivio_vuoto boolean beside the empty-archive note, and the archive path resolved at run time so --home moves it.
reason: Each of the three is a silent wrong answer. A result that stops on the default --limite 50 is indistinguishable from a complete one, which is the same trap as the API's implicit $top that this CLI exists to solve; the note travels in meta, not in results, so consumers reading results as an array keep working. An empty archive and a code that is genuinely absent from MOP both answer zero with exit 0, and the true negative is frequent (about half of CUPs are not in MOP), so a text note alone goes unnoticed. The --db default is computed when the command is built, before --home applies, so a cold test with --home silently read the real archive.
validated_outcome: 'righe bda1676b... --dove "Descrizione Titolare~COMUNE DI PALERMO" --agent' returns 50 rows with meta.nota reporting 347 total; '--home <vuota> cig 57106934F1 --agent' returns archivio_vuoto true.
